    "description": "Read sanitized visible-session history. Before reply/debug/resume. Use messageId for anchored history; sessionId selects its transcript and requires messageId. Lower limit for richer pending previews.",
    "input": "{ sessionKey: string; includeTools?: boolean; limit?: number /* integer, >= 1, <= 1000 */; messageId?: string; offset?: number /* integer, >= 0 */; pendingBefore?: number /* integer, >= 1 */; sessionId?: string; user?: string }",
    "output": "{ bytes: number; contentRedacted: boolean; contentTruncated: boolean; droppedMessages: boolean; messages: Array<unknown>; sessionKey: string; truncated: boolean; hasMore?: boolean; nextOffset?: number; offset?: number; pendingInputs?: { items: Array<{ acceptedAt: number; id: string; message: unknown; state: \"queued\" | \"cancelled\" | \"interrupted\"; queued?: true; runId?: string }>; total: number; nextBefore?: number; queuedCount?: number }; sessionLinkRule?: string; totalMessages?: number; windowReset?: boolean } | { error: string; status: \"error\" | \"forbidden\" }"
  }
]

details.name: sessions_history
details.label: Session History
details.description: Read sanitized visible-session history. Before reply/debug/resume. Use messageId for anchored history; sessionId selects its transcript and requires messageId. Omit both for the latest tail. offset pages unanchored history and is ignored with messageId. limit bounds either mode. Include tool messages with includeTools. pendingInputs are accepted inputs outside model history; page with pendingBefore=nextBefore. Cancelled/interrupted inputs never replay automatically. Lower limit for richer pending previews.
details.input: { sessionKey: string; includeTools?: boolean; limit?: number /* integer, >= 1, <= 1000 */; messageId?: string; offset?: number /* integer, >= 0 */; pendingBefore?: number /* integer, >= 1 */; sessionId?: string; user?: string }
